---
title: "`r params$title`"
report-class: supply
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
    md_extensions: "-native_divs-native_spans"
  pdf_document:
    latex_engine: xelatex
  word_document: default
params:
  title:      "Supply"
  name:       ""
  desc:       ""
  class:      "supply"
  image_file: NULL
  logos:      NULL
  info_df:    NULL
  main_plot:  NULL
  draw_file:  NULL
  supply_df:  NULL
  reserve_df: NULL
  weather_df: NULL
  cluster_df: NULL
  bar_plot:     NULL
  cost_plot:    NULL
  regions_plot: NULL
header-includes:
  - \usepackage{booktabs}
---

```{r en-setup, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)

fmt <- energyRt::report_setup()
tbl <- function(df, caption = NULL, digits = 4L, ...)
  energyRt::report_tbl(df, caption, digits, output = fmt, ...)
emit_img <- function(path, frac = 1)
  energyRt::report_img(path, frac, output = fmt)
.LAYOUT <- energyRt::report_layout()
```

```{r en-css, results='asis'}
energyRt::report_css(fmt)
```

```{r en-logo, results='asis'}
if (length(params$logos) > 0) {
  energyRt::report_img_row(params$logos, frac_total = 0.9, output = fmt)
}
```

```{r en-header, results='asis'}
energyRt::report_header(params$name, params$desc,
                        image_file = params$image_file, output = fmt)
```

```{r en-body, results='asis'}
energyRt::report_sec("Key facts", output = fmt)
tbl(params$info_df)
if (!is.null(params$draw_file)) {
  emit_img(params$draw_file, .LAYOUT$side)
}
```

```{r en-profile, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$main_plot)}
energyRt::report_sec("Year profile", output = fmt)
energyRt::report_fig(params$main_plot, 7, caption = paste("Year profile of", params$name), output = fmt)
```

```{r en-byregion, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$bar_plot) || !is.null(params$cost_plot)}
energyRt::report_sec("Supply by region", output = fmt)
if (!is.null(params$bar_plot))
  energyRt::report_fig(params$bar_plot, 7, caption = paste("Annual availability of", params$name, "by region"), output = fmt)
if (!is.null(params$cost_plot))
  energyRt::report_fig(params$cost_plot, 7, caption = paste("Supply cost of", params$name, "by region"), output = fmt)
```

```{r en-regions, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$regions_plot)}
energyRt::report_sec("Across regions", output = fmt)
energyRt::report_fig(params$regions_plot, 7, caption = paste("Availability and cost of", params$name, "across regions"), output = fmt)
```

```{r en-data, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$supply_df)}
tbl(params$supply_df, caption = "Supply data", max_rows = 40)
```

```{r en-steps, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$cluster_df)}
tbl(params$cluster_df, caption = "Supply-curve steps", max_rows = 25)
```

```{r en-reserve, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$reserve_df)}
tbl(params$reserve_df, caption = "Reserve", max_rows = 25)
```

```{r en-weather, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$weather_df)}
tbl(params$weather_df, caption = "Weather multipliers", max_rows = 25)
```
